meta.rule_version: HDMF Circular No. 460 — Maximum Fund Salary ₱10,000 (Feb 2024), unchanged for 2026

mp2.active_member_rule: at least one (1) monthly savings (contribution) within the last six (6) months
mp2.source_note: pagibigfund.gov.ph/member_savings_mp2.html (read 2026-09-23): return rates 2021–2025, P500 minimum per remittance, 5-year maturity, tax-free and government-guaranteed, annual payout or compounded at maturity, P20M principal cap, pre-termination grounds with 50% of dividends. 2011–2020 rates from the same official page's earlier version (Membership_ModifiedPagIBIG2.html, 2024 capture) — the current page lists 2021 onward only.

caps.type: Socialized house and lot, 27 sqm and above

affordable.extension_note: If the borrower's gross monthly income at the end of the five-year period is still within the income threshold, the subsidized rate applies for another three years.

housing_loan.source_note: pagibigfund.gov.ph/Availmentofnewloan.html (read 2026-09-23): rates until December 31, 2026 by repricing period and the 4.5% / 5.75% three-year promo; eligibility (24 monthly savings, ≤65 at application, ≤70 at maturity); term up to 30 years not beyond age 70; MRI/SRI and fire insurance; one-month Housing Loan Reserve Payment. Circular No. 491 (Board meeting 2026-05-11): loans up to ₱10M, above ₱6M subject to 90% loan-to-appraised value.

short_term_loans.active_rule_local: at least one (1) monthly membership savings within the last six (6) months before applying
short_term_loans.active_rule_ofw: at least one (1) monthly membership savings within the last twelve (12) months before applying

mpl.circular: Pag-IBIG Fund Circular No. 469 — Enhanced Guidelines on the Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose Loan (MPL) Program (Board approval March 12, 2025; signed April 30, 2025)

calamity.circular: Pag-IBIG Fund Circular No. 470 — Enhanced Guidelines on the Pag-IBIG Fund Calamity Loan Program (Board approval March 12, 2025; signed April 30, 2025)

short_term_loans.source_note: Read 2026-09-23 on pagibigfund.gov.ph (MPL and Calamity Loan pages; text of Circulars 469 and 470). Loan = lowest of the amount applied for, 90% of the Total Accumulated Value (TAV: member and employer savings plus dividends) less any outstanding MPL/Calamity/HELPs balance, and capacity to pay. MPL 1.4583% a month on the diminishing balance; Calamity 5.95% a year; interest runs during the grace period and is amortized over the term. Penalty 1/20 of 1% of the unpaid amount per day of delay.
